p1_body: Paint protection film (PPF) and window film protect your car's surface with a clear layer.
p2_body: Every installation is done by an authorized Olexfilms dealer. It starts with a measurement and is tailored to your car.
p3_body: Your digital warranty is registered to your car, the parts applied and its term. It is verified by QR, transfers when you sell the car, and stays on your phone even if the paper card is lost.
